ns2:course.label: IB Merit Program Discussion
ns2:course.description: Provides the extra earned credit hours for students enrolled in the Merit Program in IB 202, IB 203, or IB 204. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same term to a maximum of 6 hours. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 10 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
